description: This PHP class defines a data model for representing a claim request within the OrangeHRM HR management system API. It uses annotations for OpenAPI documentation and includes methods for serialization and normalization, initialized with a ClaimRequest entity.

classes.name: MyClaimRequestModel
classes.description: A model class that represents claim request data for API serialization and documentation purposes,, constructed from a ClaimRequest entity.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a ClaimRequest entity and configures filters and attribute names for serialization.
